title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant

translated_title: 真实的PMID，错误的论文：生物医学论断验证智能体的框架设计
translated_abstract: 文献检索语言智能体正在成为生命科学领域科研助手的标准组成部分，然而关于其框架中哪些部分真正重要，目前缺乏受控的实验证据。我们以实时PubMed API作为唯一工具，在生物医学论断验证任务上进行了受控消融实验。在固定骨干模型和输出格式的前提下，我们比较了四种框架：闭卷直接回答、以论断本身作为查询的单次检索、能够自行编写PubMed查询的ReAct式智能体，以及给定标准摘要的oracle（理想上界），每种框架均使用两个高效的前沿骨干模型。天真的单次检索仅能为6%的论断找到标准论文，并且只是将过度自信的错误转化为弃权，而没有提升准确率。让模型自行构造查询可将标准论文的召回率提升三倍，并产生最佳的判定结果（准确率为62%，而其他现实可行的框架为49-59%），尽管这些差异并不显著。
tldr: 该论文通过受控消融实验发现，在基于实时PubMed API的生物医学论断验证任务中，让语言智能体自行构造查询的框架设计能将标准论文召回率提升三倍并取得最佳准确率（62%），而简单的单次检索仅能为6%的论断找到标准论文且无法提升准确率。
en_tdlr: Through controlled ablations on biomedical claim verification using the live PubMed API, this paper shows that letting language agents formulate their own PubMed queries triples gold-paper recall and achieves the best accuracy (62%), while naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and fails to improve accuracy.
